description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Private Beach Access just steps away* Stunning Gulf Views from 2nd and 3rd Floors* 6 Bikes Complimentary * Sparkling Community Pool* Multiple Balconies and 2 Living Areas * Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Only 1 mile to Rosemary Beach- 9 miles to Seaside to the west - 10 miles to Pier Park to the east* Professionally Managed; 24/7 ServiceWelcome to your home away from home! Churchill Dunes is a 5 bedroom, 3.5 bath luxury home just off scenic Hwy 30A in Inlet Beach. With over 2600sqft of living space, this picturesque beach home features upscale décor and high-end finishes, including custom reclaimed oak hardwood flooring throughout! On the first floor you'll find three bedrooms including a bunk room, laundry room, and access to the one-car garage. The main living area and a chef's dream kitchen is found on the second floor which has impact-rated sliding glass doors that showcase endless emerald green ocean views. You'll also find the master suite on the second floor which boosts a large walk-in closet, a rainfall shower head in the large walk-in shower, and access to a private balcony which is the perfect spot for your morning cup of coffee. On the third floor, secluded enough to be a bedroom is an additional living area and two sets of hand-crafted bunk beds, and access to another balcony to view those vibrant Florida sunsets. With private beach access, a sparkling community pool, and world-class dining and shopping nearby, Churchill Dunes is the perfect vacation destination for your family for years to come!*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* *** There is new construction behind this home***Bed Setup:1st Floor:Bunk Room: Twin BunkbedGuest Bedroom: Queen BedGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed2nd Floor:Master Bedroom: King Bed3rd Floor:Bunkbed Loft: 2 Bunk Beds Barbary Coast Development of Inlet Beach is located just steps away from the emerald water of 30A. Nestled on the east end of 30A near Rosemary Beach, this exclusive community is a short bike ride to fine dining, shopping and year-round family fun at the new 30Avenue development. The Barbary Coast Development offers a private community pool and a private walkway to the white sand within a few steps of the home. Area Attractions:Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center w/coffee shop, bike, and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar-white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!Maximum Occupancy = 12Maximum Parking = 4 VehiclesShort-Term Vacation Rental Certificate # = STR24-000882TDT Registration # = 031470 Read less
